svg.title: GRAPHIC 11.5 — Battery Strength Changes the Outcome
svg.desc: Two stacked comparison panels show the same robot, same code, and same 500 millisecond command. A full battery carries the robot across a gap while a tired battery leaves it short. Robot photograph © Pololu Corporation — pololu.com
svg.text: GRAPHIC 11.5 — Battery Strength Changes the Outcome
Same command time. Different battery strength. Different travel distance.
